title: Number of Enclaves
statement: Return the number of land cells (1) that cannot reach the border by 4-directional moves. Land on the border, and land connected to it, can escape.
hints: Flood every border land cell and mark the connected land as escaped.
Count the land cells that remain unmarked.
This is the same border-flood idea as surrounded regions, counting cells instead of flipping them.

approaches.name: DFS from each land cell
approaches.explanation: See whether the component touches the border.

editorial: Start DFS or BFS from every border land cell and mark visited land. Those cells can walk off the board. Every other land cell is an enclave. Count them.

examples.explanation: Every land cell can reach the border.
